_doc: Unified system configuration for the water-quality monitoring pipeline. All tunable constants live here; module constructors read defaults from this file via src/config.py. Explicit constructor overrides always win (needed for tests and per-deployment tuning).

sensors._doc: Mirrors sensors_config.json — single source of truth for sensor metadata.

retraining._doc: Governs the two-gate retrain policy (volume + drift) and sliding window.
retraining._min_new_rows_rationale: Below 60 rows the RMSE ratio estimate has high variance; spurious drift triggers occur. 60 rows ≈ 2 months of daily data at C-1 cadence.
retraining._rmse_ratio_rationale: 10% RMSE degradation on the recent window triggers drift signal. Validated against the C-1 KS power analysis (see drift_detector.py).
retraining._tolerance_rationale: Candidate accepted if new_rmse <= old_rmse*(1+tolerance). 2% accommodates XGBoost stochastic variance without blocking valid promotions.
retraining._rejection_alert_rationale: Alert fires every N consecutive rejections (modulo policy). Documented in retrain_manager.py section 'Alert policy'.
retraining._max_history_rationale: THEORETICAL — not validated on C-1 (single year). Balances seasonal coverage (≥3 cycles) against regime staleness (>10yr dilutes current signal). Revalidate when multi-year data is available.

anomaly_detection._doc: Isolation Forest trained on prediction residuals (residual-based approach, A-12/N-2).
anomaly_detection._score_threshold_rationale: Normalized score in [0,1]; ≥0.5 → anomaly flag. Follows A-12 PADSV convention.
anomaly_detection._contamination_rationale: Conservative prior: genuine sensor faults expected rare in a mine-adjacent station. Affects IF internal offset but NOT our custom score normalization.

forecasting._horizon_rationale: 3-day horizon matches the dataset's daily granularity and typical operational planning window. Error accumulation is acceptable up to ~72h (validated on EC).

validation._doc: Physical plausibility bounds used by src/data/validation.py. Rows outside these bounds are rejected with an explicit reason — never silently.

EC.note: Upper limit for heavily polluted freshwater

Turbidity.note: Extreme upper for mining-area flood events

WQI.note: Weighted Arithmetic Index, unbounded in theory

logging._doc: Logging configuration applied by src/_logging.py. Console: INFO+. File: WARNING+.
